record.field: Create a Joplin note (joplin.note) from text you supply. Use when the user asks you to save/remember something, or when you propose saving and the user agrees. Returns the new note's id, title and joplin_id. Required: title. Optional: body (Markdown), folder (notebook name — created if missing), tags (list of tag names — created if missing). The identifier is generated by the note model; you cannot and must not supply it. Creating a note is a write and passes the approval gate.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"title": {"type": "string", "description": "Note title (required). Short and specific."}, "body": {"type": "string", "description": "Note body in Markdown."}, "folder": {"type": "string", "description": "Notebook name. Created if it does not exist."}, "tags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "Tag names. Created if they do not exist."}}, "required": ["title"]}

Create a Joplin note (joplin.note) that summarises an existing Odoo record. Use when a record's content is worth keeping as knowledge. Required: model (technical name) and res_id. Optional: title (defaults to the record's display name), body (your Markdown summary; defaults to a short generated summary), folder, tags. The model must be one you are allowed to read — a model outside your scope is denied. Fails with an actionable error when the record does not exist. Creating a note is a write and passes the approval gate.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"model": {"type": "string", "description": "Odoo model technical name, e.g. project.task (required)."}, "res_id": {"type": "integer", "description": "Id of the record to summarise (required)."}, "title": {"type": "string", "description": "Note title. Defaults to the model name plus the record display name."}, "body": {"type": "string", "description": "Markdown summary of the record. Defaults to a short generated summary."}, "folder": {"type": "string", "description": "Notebook name. Created if it does not exist."}, "tags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "Tag names. Created if they do not exist."}}, "required": ["model", "res_id"]}

Create a Joplin note (joplin.note) that summarises the current conversation. Use when a conclusion reached in dialogue is worth keeping. You supply the title and the Markdown body — you already hold the conversation in context, so summarise it yourself. Required: title and body. Optional: folder, tags. Fails with an actionable error when the body is empty (nothing to summarise). Creating a note is a write and passes the approval gate.

{"type": "object", "properties": {"title": {"type": "string", "description": "Note title (required). Short and specific."}, "body": {"type": "string", "description": "Markdown summary of the conversation (required)."}, "folder": {"type": "string", "description": "Notebook name. Created if it does not exist."}, "tags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "Tag names. Created if they do not exist."}}, "required": ["title", "body"]}
